name: onesource
description: Resolve B2B people and companies to one stable ID from a verified identity ledger, then enrich, find, discover and validate with the five OneSource tools. Credit-aware skills, a lead-qualification agent and a local, PII-free usage log.

api_key.title: OneSource API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to sign in with your iCustomer account (run /mcp, pick onesource, choose Authenticate). For CI and headless runs, paste an os_live_ key: Claude Code keeps it in your system keychain and sends it only to the OneSource server below, as the x-api-key header.

server_url.title: OneSource MCP server URL
server_url.description: The OneSource MCP endpoint every tool call goes to. Keep the default unless iCustomer gave you another one.
